description: Fix a usort-based priority queue that breaks ties non-deterministically (usort is not stable in PHP) into an insertion-order-stable one
prompts: Create src/StablePriorityQueue.php defining namespace App and class StablePriorityQueue with push(int $priority, string $value): void and pop(): string. The obvious usort($this->items, fn($a, $b) => $a['priority'] <=> $b['priority']) on every push is NOT enough on its own: usort is not guaranteed stable in PHP, so ties between equal-priority items can come out in any order. Add an explicit monotonically increasing insertion-order field to each pushed item and use it as the comparator's tiebreaker, so: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO).

reference_solution.src/StablePriorityQueue.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class StablePriorityQueue
{
    private array $items = [];
    private int $counter = 0;

    public function push(int $priority, string $value): void
    {
        $this->items[] = ['priority' => $priority, 'order' => $this->counter, 'value' => $value];
        $this->counter++;
        usort($this->items, function ($a, $b) {
            return $a['priority'] <=> $b['priority'] ?: $a['order'] <=> $b['order'];
        });
    }

    public function pop(): string
    {
        $item = array_shift($this->items);
        return $item['value'];
    }
}

namespace App;

class StablePriorityQueue
{
    private array $items = [];
    private int $counter = 0;

    public function push(int $priority, string $value): void
    {
        $this->items[] = ['priority' => $priority, 'order' => $this->counter, 'value' => $value];
        $this->counter--;
        usort($this->items, function ($a, $b) {
            return $a['priority'] <=> $b['priority'] ?: $a['order'] <=> $b['order'];
        });
    }

    public function pop(): string
    {
        $item = array_shift($this->items);
        return $item['value'];
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/StablePriorityQueueTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/StablePriorityQueue.php';

final class StablePriorityQueueTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPriorityOrder(): void
    {
        $q = new \App\StablePriorityQueue();
        $q->push(5, "low");
        $q->push(1, "high");
        $q->push(3, "mid");
        $this->assertSame("high", $q->pop());
        $this->assertSame("mid", $q->pop());
        $this->assertSame("low", $q->pop());
    }

    public function testEqualPriorityIsFifoAcrossManyItems(): void
    {
        $q = new \App\StablePriorityQueue();
        for ($i = 0; $i < 20; $i++) {
            $q->push(1, chr(ord('a') + $i));
        }
        for ($i = 0; $i < 20; $i++) {
            $this->assertSame(chr(ord('a') + $i), $q->pop());
        }
    }
}
